articles.summary: This blog explores why a single temperature reading may not provide enough insight into molten metal processes. It examines measurement challenges in demanding environments and how combining pyrometry with thermal imaging can provide a more complete view of changing thermal conditions, helping manufacturers better understand process consistency, equipment performance and product quality.
articles.title: When a Single Temperature Reading Isn't Enough
